final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS c2, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) AS c3 FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.invoice_number AS inv, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c3 - s2.m AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.m) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(diff) FROM s3
